row:
VET Talks is a project developed by IVSA Standing Committee on Veterinary Education (SCoVE) and Wikivet.
VET Talks aims to provide short and informative lectures on any topics within veterinary medicine, designed to supplement the learning of Veterinary Students. 
If you would like to support VET Talks, please email us at vettalks@ivsa.org

Or alternatively, email us at:
SCoVE Home Page: http://ivsascove.wix.com/ivsascove
EDU+ (SCoVE Project): http://ivsascove.wix.com/eduplatform
Wikivet: https://en.wikivet.net
